theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Technology (+0.25%) and Industrials (-0.06%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-0.18%) and Financials (-0.17%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.02%, defensives -0.15%, and value/cyclicals -0.14% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.26%, Dow -0.04%, Nasdaq +0.54% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.61%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 0.27% to 14.51, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.14% to $4,452.10, crude oil was little changed at $81.22, and bitcoin gained 0.35% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
